title: Afterlife for an Atheist
question: Choose the homepage composition to carry into the light/dark and mobile chapter designs. These are visual mockups, not the working website.

options.label: A · Centered introduction
options.thesis: A centered book introduction above a compact chapter index.
options.viewport: Title and small ink study lead into a three-column chapter index.
options.risk: The introduction takes more attention before the chapter links.

options.label: B · Contents page
options.thesis: A familiar numbered contents list with a small illustrated introduction.
options.viewport: Title and illustration share the opening, followed by nine full-width chapter rows.
options.risk: The vertical list takes more scrolling on a phone.

options.label: C · Chapter directory
options.thesis: A horizontal introduction above three columns of chapter links.
options.viewport: Title, illustration, and explanation form a shallow band above an open chapter directory.
options.risk: The multiple columns need a deliberate reading order on mobile.
